matches.rationale: pred1 identifies the same underlying data-integrity issue: the abstract's performance numbers are inflated and inconsistent with the detailed results reported elsewhere in the paper. Although the exact numeric values differ, both refer to the abstract overstating TTFT/throughput gains relative to the paper's own evidence.
No finding addresses the burst tolerance definition contradiction in Equation 1 / Section 3.1.
No finding mentions omitted baseline configuration details for vLLM and DistServe in the experimental setup.

pred2 identifies the same Figure 6 inconsistency: the claimed 4.5× throughput multiplier is arithmetically incompatible with the displayed throughput values. This matches gt4's inflated throughput claim relative to the actual table values.
No finding addresses the unsupported generalization about universal applicability across all MLLM architectures.
No finding mentions the fabricated citation [61] or the misrepresented prior-art landscape in Related Work.
No finding discusses the corruption in Equation 3 involving the undefined β penalty factor or the context switch from decode to prefill.
No finding raises the omission of ethics, consent, or data-provenance considerations for the datasets.
No finding identifies the promotional overstatement in the Introduction about eliminating all inference bottlenecks.
No finding discusses the abstract's characterization of unified multimodal prefix caching versus its actual treatment in Section 3.2.
No finding addresses the ablation study text obscuring the unequal performance contributions of the two optimizations.
No finding mentions ElasticMM being tested with optimized CUDA kernels or custom memory allocators unavailable to baselines.
No finding addresses the Conclusion's overclaim that SLO compliance is guaranteed under all workload conditions.
No finding mentions the false attribution of encoder-decoder MLLM architectures to Vaswani et al. in Preliminaries.
No finding discusses the Conclusion's omission of limitations, risks, or societal impact.
